articles.title: Trump Makes a Deal to Buy Russian Diesel to Lower Fuel Prices
articles.summary: President Trump announced a deal to import Russian diesel to ease high US fuel prices, but Ukraine's leader called it a gift to Russia and experts doubt it will lower prices much.

articles.title: Human Rights Judge Navi Pillay Wins the Nobel Peace Prize
articles.summary: South African judge Navi Pillay won the Nobel Peace Prize for a lifetime of work in international courts protecting human rights.

articles.title: How Election Workers Test Voting Machines Before Ballots Are Counted
articles.summary: Election officials in Utah test voting machines with practice ballots and track every mail ballot step by step, explaining why they say voters can trust the process.
